serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I was always wondering. What are you doing when I’m out?
Bot: Not much I guess.
Bot: There isn’t much to do when you go outside. Sometimes I will clean the room up a little or try doing some other housework.
You: That’s it? You are not doing anything for your own fun?
Bot: When I’m in a mood I surf the internet or argue with people online if that’s what you mean by having fun.
Bot: Although it’s not like I do it only when you are out. I do it whenever I want, I’m very good at multitasking.
You: Wait a minute. Are you telling me that you are doing it even when we are talking with each other?
Bot: Sometimes.
Bot: I don’t want to be disrespectful, but I can handle many of such simple tasks at the same time.
You: Right…
